❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between a US gallon and an imperial gallon?

A US gallon is 3.78541 litres; an imperial (UK) gallon is 4.54609 litres. This converter uses the US gallon, which is standard in most recipes and fuel figures.

How many millilitres are in a US cup?

One US legal cup is 240 ml; the customary US cup used in cooking is 236.588 ml, which is what this converter uses.

Are cubic meters and litres related?

Yes — 1 cubic meter is exactly 1,000 litres, and 1 litre is exactly 1 cubic decimetre.
